details: "Gerry" Tesauro is an American computer scientist and a researcher at IBM, known for his development of TD-Gammon, a backgammon program that taught itself to play at a world-championship level through self-play and temporal difference learning, an early success in reinforcement learning and neural networks. He subsequently researched on autonomic computing, multi-agent systems for e-commerce, and contributed to the game strategy algorithms for IBM Watson.
